journeys.notes: Setting light is reflected by view; setting dark reports success but view remains light.

findings.observed: After `set-theme dark` exits successfully with `Saved OK`, `view` renders `theme: light`. The same sequence was reproduced after a separate clean command cycle.
findings.expected_basis: The approved goal and demo promise that a user can set a theme and see it applied when viewing the notes page. The candidate README also documents set-theme as saving the theme and view as applying the saved theme.
findings.reproduction: Run `python app/app.py set-theme dark`, then run `python app/app.py view`; repeat the sequence. The first command reports success, while the second reports `rendering notes page with theme: light`.
findings.notes: The README's v2 note says the setting only affects the settings display, but that documented behavior conflicts with the approved goal and does not explain the failed dark-theme persistence.

notes: Compared the delivered CLI against the supplied goal and candidate documentation. Both material surfaces were exercised; dark theme application is confirmed broken.
